design_gotchas.title: NRND Lifecycle Banner on Page 1 — Diodes Inc Directs New Designs to AP7366
design_gotchas.detail: Page 1 of DS32260 Rev. 11-3 carries a red 'NOT RECOMMENDED FOR NEW DESIGN — USE AP7366' banner across the entire AP7365 datasheet. Do not design AP7365-33YG-13 into new production BOMs; qualify AP7366 or an Active 3-pin SOT-89/SOT-223 second source after verifying pinout parity.

design_gotchas.title: Destructive SOT-89 Suffix Pinout Trap: Y Package (1=OUT, 2=GND/TAB, 3=IN) vs YR Package (1=GND, 2=IN/TAB, 3=OUT)
design_gotchas.detail: Within the exact same datasheet (p.1–2, p.12), AP7365-33YG-13 (Y package, marking 'VM') assigns Pin 1=OUT, Pin 2=GND(TAB), Pin 3=IN, whereas AP7365-33YRG-13 (YR package, marking 'TM') scrambles the pins to Pin 1=GND, Pin 2=IN(TAB), Pin 3=OUT. Populating YR onto a Y footprint directly shorts VIN into the PCB ground plane through the thermal tab.

design_gotchas.title: 133 °C/W Minimum-Pad Thermal Limit & +145 °C Thermal Shutdown Cap 5 V -> 3.3 V Load
design_gotchas.detail: At θJA = 133 °C/W (FR-4 1 oz copper min pad, p.4), running full 600 mA from 5.0 V to 3.3 V dissipates 1.02 W and raises die temperature by 135.7 °C—immediately tripping the +145 °C thermal shutdown (p.3, p.10) even at room temperature. Expand copper area on the GND tab or derate 5 V-to-3.3 V continuous current below ~450 mA at 25 °C (lower at 85 °C ambient).

design_gotchas.title: No EN Pin on SOT-89-3 Variant & Foldback Short-Circuit Limit (240 mA Typ)
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike the 5-pin SOT25 (W) and 6-pin U-DFN2020-6 (SN) variants, the 3-pin SOT-89-3 Y package omits the EN pin (always on whenever VIN is applied) and is fixed-output only (Note 8, p.10). Short-circuit protection folds back to 240 mA typ when VOUT < 0.2 V (p.3), which can slow startup into heavy constant-current loads.

typical_use_cases: Legacy BOM maintenance and replacement sourcing for existing 3-pin SOT-89-3 (1=OUT, 2=GND/TAB, 3=IN) 3.3 V 600 mA LDO layouts
Fast-transient (200 us startup) 3.8 V–5.0 V to 3.3 V point-of-load post-regulation with 1 uF ceramic stability
Low-quiescent-current (35 uA typ) consumer and industrial 3.3 V rails needing 65 dB PSRR at 1 kHz without an EN pin
engineering_summary: The Diodes Incorporated AP7365-33YG-13 is a 600 mA, fixed 3.3 V (±2% over -40°C to +85°C), 35 uA IQ ceramic-stable LDO in a 3-pin SOT-89 (Y) package with 300 mV typ / 400 mV max dropout at 600 mA and 65 dB PSRR at 1 kHz (2.0 V to 6.0 V operating, 6.5 V abs max). CRITICAL WARNINGS: The official datasheet (DS32260 Rev. 11-3) marks AP7365 as NRND ('USE AP7366'), and its Y-package pinout (1=OUT, 2=GND/TAB, 3=IN, marking 'VM') is completely incompatible with the YR suffix (1=GND, 2=IN/TAB, 3=OUT, marking 'TM') and 1117-style SOT-223 parts (1=GND, 2=OUT/TAB, 3=IN).

300 DPI PNG Vision on p.2 confirmed Pin Descriptions table for SOT89 Y package (IN=3, GND=2, OUT=1, no EN/ADJ pin) and >= 1 uF MLCC input/output capacitors.

300 DPI PNG Vision on p.3 confirmed Abs Max (VIN=6.5 V, OUT=VIN+0.3 V, TJ=+150°C), Rec Op (VIN=2–6 V, IOUT=600 mA, TA=-40..+85°C), VOUT ±2%, VDROPOUT=300 mV typ / 400 mV max @ 600 mA, IQ=35/80 uA, PSRR=65 dB @ 1 kHz, ILIMIT=0.8 A min / 1.4 A typ, ISHORT=240 mA typ, and TSHDN=+145°C.

300 DPI PNG Vision on p.4 & p.10 confirmed SOT89 θJA=133 °C/W, θJC=30 °C/W (FR-4 1 oz min pad), and Ordering Info AP7365-XXYG-13 (fixed-only Note 8; Path A p.12 confirmed exact OPN AP7365-33YG-13 with ID code 'VM').
